# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: assumptions

As of 2026-09-30.

| Assumption | Type | Criticality | Applies to | Test | Evidence | Status |
|------------|------|-------------|------------|------|----------|--------|
| Member leaders can free enough time to attend cohort sessions and coaching. (`asm-time-to-attend`) | Implementation | High | ln-cohorts-skills, ln-cohorts-ties | Track the share of enrolled leaders who attend at least three quarters of sessions, and ask drop-outs why they left. | ev-attendance-records | Holding (assessed) |
| Leaders put coaching-based skills into practice back at their organizations. (`asm-skills-applied`) _(inferred)_ | Behavioral | Critical | ln-skills-practice | Interview a sample of cohort graduates six months later and score their practice with the maturity rubric. | ev-peer-learning | Untested (as written) |
| Small and large members come to see each other as peers rather than as competitors for the same funding. (`asm-peer-trust`) _(hypothesis)_ | Contextual | Medium | ln-ties-network, ln-network-collab, ln-ties-positions | — | ev-collab-study | Untested (as written) |
| Vendors offer meaningful discounts and service terms at the volume the members can pool. (`asm-vendor-terms`) | External | High | ln-services-use, ln-pooled-overhead | Compare pooled vendor quotes with the prices a sample of members pay now, before signing each agreement. | ev-pooled-purchasing | Holding (as written) |
| The grants calendar stays accurate enough that members trust it. (`asm-calendar-reliable`) _(hypothesis)_ | Implementation | Medium | ln-calendar-use, ln-calendar-pipeline | — | — | Holding (as written) |
| Time and money saved on overhead are reinvested in programs, leadership, and joint work rather than absorbed elsewhere. (`asm-savings-reinvested`) _(inferred)_ | Causal | Medium | ln-overhead-capable, ln-overhead-collab, ln-overhead-sustain | — | ev-member-survey | Untested (as written) |
| Regional funders keep funding priorities open enough that better-matched applications succeed. (`asm-funders-fit`) _(inferred)_ | External | Medium | ln-pipeline-sustain | — | ev-funder-interview | At risk (as written) |
| The county planning office and municipal councils stay open to a standing channel with the network. (`asm-officials-receptive`) | Partnership | High | ln-channel-officials, ln-officials-voice, ln-voice-resvoice | Review the county planning calendar each quarter for processes that invited members, and ask planning staff whether the channel was used. | ev-county-planning-notes | At risk (assessed) |
| Once members adopt a joint position, they keep to it in public rather than splintering. (`asm-positions-hold`) _(hypothesis)_ | Behavioral | High | ln-know-positions, ln-positions-collab, ln-positions-voice, ln-collab-resvoice | After each joint position, record whether any member publicly took a conflicting stance within the following quarter. | ev-coalition-case | Holding (assessed) |
| Stronger, more connected, better-funded members deliver more and better services to residents. (`asm-members-deliver`) _(inferred)_ | Causal | Critical | ln-capable-access, ln-collab-access, ln-sustain-access | Compare service volumes and waits at members with high and low maturity ratings, using the annual member service-count report. | ev-county-services | Untested (as written) |
| Members who benefit from the network recruit their peers. (`asm-peers-recruit`) | Behavioral | Low | ln-collab-recruit | — | ev-workshop-notes | Holding (as written) |
| Leadership turnover at members stays low enough for new practices to take root. (`asm-leadership-turnover`) _(hypothesis)_ | Contextual | Medium | ln-practice-capable | — | — | Untested (as written) |
